sections.title: Description
sections.markdown:
## Why

Shoppers lose the products they liked between visits.

## What

A heart on each product saves it; the wishlist page lists what was saved.

sections.title: Acceptance criteria
sections.markdown:
- [ ] A heart on a product saves it
- [ ] The wishlist lists every saved product
